task.question: How many people were killed in the earthquake that struck off the island of Flores, Indonesia on August 15, 2026?
task.evidence: August 15 – At least 129 people are killed and nearly 1,300 injured when a magnitude 7.7 earthquake strikes off the island of Flores, Indonesia.

answer:
The earthquake that struck off the island of Flores, Indonesia on August 15, 2026, killed at least 142 people. 

FINAL: 142

How many people were killed in the earthquake that struck off the island of Flores, Indonesia on August 15, 2026?

[2026 Flores earthquake] On 15 August 2026, at 05:58 WITA (UTC+8), a Mw 7.8 earthquake struck off the coast of the island of Flores in East Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia. The earthquake was caused by movement on the Flores back-arc thrust fault located north of the island. Seismic observatories recorded a maximum Modified Mercalli intensity of VIII (Severe) on Flores. It triggered a tsunami with a maximum recorded height of 2.68 m (8 ft 10 in). At least 142 people were killed in the earthquake while another 1,776 people were injured. Approximately 98,900 homes were damaged, 27,400 of which collapsed or were badly damaged. | other articles: 2026, 2026 in Indonesia
